noRegimeRoutes.label: Read the jurisdiction's filing-officer statute from the legislature's own site
noRegimeRoutes.note: The generalising question, asked of every state: which statute defines the filing officer, and what does it route to whom? Answered for AZ (A.R.S. § 16-928), NH (RSA 664:7 and 664:6) and NJ. Unanswered for any jurisdiction absent from this registry. A jurisdiction we have not read is a jurisdiction we have not read — never a jurisdiction with no filing officer.
